newsitem.title: USA: NiGas limits Ill. natgas withdrawals Thurs.
newsitem.headline: NiGas limits Ill. natgas withdrawals Thurs.

text.p: Northern Illinois Gas Co declared a "critical day" for Thursday, limiting natural gas deliveries from Illinois pipelines and storage facilities due to severe cold in the Midwest, the company said Wednesday.
A company spokeswoman said the critical day so far applies only to Thursday, but that it might be extended to Friday if the cold weather persists.

Forecasters are calling for sharply colder weather for the upper Midwest from Thursday and into the weekend, with temperatures expected to drop to 15-25 degrees Fahrenheit below the seasonal norm from late Thursday or early Friday.
A critical day affects deliveries for the day beginning at noon (1200 CST) of the following day, in this case Thursday.
It can be declared from November 1 to April 1 when storage withdrawals and suppplies from NiGas storage facilities at times need to be limited to meet contractual obligations.
The limits on withdrawals are typically triggered by cold weather.
